np.asarray(trials['free_water'][:]).astype(bool)\\n        trial_start = np.asarray(trials['start_time'][:], dtype=np.float64)\\n        trial_stop = np.asarray(trials['stop_time'][:], dtype=np.float64)\\n\\n        go_times = _events(nwb, 'go_start_times')\\n        if len(go_times) != n_trials_raw:\\n            io.close()\\n            raise RuntimeError(f'{session_id}: {len(go_times)} go cues for {n_trials_raw} trials')\\n\\n        # ---------------- units ---------------------------------------------------\\n        units = nwb.units\\n        classification = np.asarray(units['classification'][:])\\n        good = np.flatnonzero(classification == 'good')\\n        if len(good) == 0:\\n            io.close()\\n            return None\\n\\n        anno = np.asarray(units['anno_name'][:])[good]\\n        egroups = np.asarray(units['electrode_group'].data[:])[good]\\n        probe_target = np.array([json.loads(g.location)['brain_regions'] for g in egroups])\\n\\n        # unit -> electrode -> CCF x, for the hemisphere rule of the reference code\\n        er = units['electrodes']\\n        cum = np.asarray(er.data[:])\\n        elec_idx = np.asarray(er.target.data[:])[cum - 1][good]\\n        elec_x = np.asarray(nwb.electrodes['x'][:], dtype=np.float64)[elec_idx]\\n        hemisphere = np.where(elec_x >= ML_MIDLINE_UM, 'left', 'right')\\n        # fall back on the insertion's targeted hemisphere where CCF x is missing\\n        missing = np.isnan(elec_x)\\n        if missing.any():\\n            hemisphere[missing] = np.array([t.split(' ')[0] for t in probe_target])[missing]\\n\\n        region_name = np.array([annotation_to_region(a, t) for a, t in zip(anno, probe_target)])\\n        unknown = region_name == None  # noqa: E711\\n        if unknown.any():\\n            print(f'  WARNING {session_id}: {unknown.sum()} units with unmapped annotation '\\n                  f'{set(anno[unknown])}', flush=True)\\n            region_name[unknown] = 'OtherCortex'\\n        region_idx = np.array([REGIONS.index(r) for r in region_name], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n        # ---------------- trial curation -----------------------------------------\\n        # (a) reference `get_regular_trial_mask`: no auto-water, no free-water trials\\n        keep = (~auto_water) & (~free_water)\\n        # (b) recording-stability annotation: keep only trials annotated 'good' for\\n        #     every retained unit (i.e. for every probe insertion contributing units)\\n        is_good_trials = np.asarray(units['is_good_trials'][:])[good]   # (n_good, n_trials)\\n        keep &= is_good_trials.all(axis=0)\\n        keep_idx = np.flatnonzero(keep)\\n        n_trials = len(keep_idx)\\n        if n_trials < 2:\\n            io.close()\\n            return None\\n\\n        go = go_times[keep_idx]\\n        timing['setup'] = time.time() - t0\\n\\n        # ---------------- neural ---------------------------------------------------\\n        t1 = time.time()\\n        sv = units['spike_times']\\n        ends = np.asarray(sv.data[:])\\n        starts = np.concatenate([[0], ends[:-1]])\\n        flat_spikes = np.asarray(sv.target.data[:], dtype=np.float64)\\n\\n        n_neurons = len(good)\\n        fr = np.empty((n_neurons, n_trials, NBINS), dtype=np.float32)\\n        for i, u in enumerate(good):\\n            st = flat_spikes[starts[u]:ends[u]]\\n            fr[i] = bin_spikes_rate(st, go)\\n        timing['neural'] = time.time() - t1\\n\\n        # ---------------- inputs ---------------------------------------------------\\n        t1 = time.time()\\n        # tone onset := last sample-epoch start before the go cue\\n        sample_start = _events(nwb, 'sample_start_times')\\n        tone_pos = np.searchsorted(sample_start, go, side='right') - 1\\n        if np.any(tone_pos < 0):\\n            raise RuntimeError(f'{session_id}: trial without a preceding sample epoch')\\n        tone_time = sample_start[tone_pos]\\n        # time from tone onset at each bin centre (seconds, continuous)\\n        time_from_tone = BIN_CENTERS[None, :] + (go - tone_time)[:, None]   # (n_trials, NBINS)\\n\\n        photostim_on = np.zeros((n_trials, NBINS), dtype=np.float32)\\n        try:\\n            ps_start = _events(nwb, 'photostim_start_times')\\n            ps_stop = _events(nwb, 'photostim_stop_times')\\n        except KeyError:\\n            ps_start = ps_stop = np.zeros(0)\\n        if len(ps_start) and len(ps_start) == len(ps_stop):\\n            for j, g in enumerate(go):\\n                m = (ps_stop > g + OFF_START) & (ps_start < g + OFF_END)\\n                if m.any():\\n                    photostim_on[j] = interval_overlap_bins(ps_start[m], ps_stop[m], g)\\n        elif len(ps_start) != len(ps_stop):\\n            print(f'  WARNING {session_id}: photostim start/stop counts differ '\\n                  f'({len(ps_start)}/{len(ps_stop)}); photostim input left at 0', flush=True)\\n        timing['input'] = time.time() - t1\\n\\n        # ---------------- outputs --------------------------------------------------\\n        t1 = time.time()\\n        instr_k = instruction[keep_idx]\\n        out_k = outcome[keep_idx]\\n        early_k = early_lick[keep_idx]\\n\\n        # choice: hit -> instructed side, miss -> opposite side, ignore -> no lick\\n        choice = np.full(n_trials, CHOICE_NOLICK, dtype=np.int64)\\n        hit = out_k == 'hit'\\n        miss = out_k == 'miss'\\n        choice[hit & (instr_k == 'left')] = CHOICE_LEFT\\n        choice[hit & (instr_k == 'right')] = CHOICE_RIGHT\\n        choice[miss & (instr_k == 'left')] = CHOICE_RIGHT\\n        choice[miss & (instr_k == 'right')] = CHOICE_LEFT\\n\\n        outcome_code = np.array([OUTCOME_CODE[o] for o in out_k], dtype=np.int64)\\n        early_code = (early_k == 'early').astype(np.int64)\\n\\n        tongue_y_binned, tongue_visible_frac = bin_tongue(nwb, trial_start, go, keep_idx)\\n        tongue_class, pct = discretise_tongue(tongue_y_binned)\\n        timing['output'] = time.time() - t1\\n\\n        io.close()\\n\\n    # ---------------- assemble ----------------------------------------------------\\n    neural = [fr[:, j, :] for j in range(n_trials)]\\n    inputs = [np.stack([time_from_tone[j], photostim_on[j]]).astype(np.float32)\\n              for j in range(n_trials)]\\n    outputs = [np.stack([np.full(NBINS, choice[j]),\\n                         np.full(NBINS, outcome_code[j]),\\n                         np.full(NBINS, early_code[j]),\\n                         tongue_class[j]]).astype(np.int64)\\n               for j in range(n_trials)]\\n\\n    result = dict(\\n        session_id=session_id,\\n        subject=subject,\\n        file=os.path.basename(path),\\n        neural=neural,\\n        input=inputs,\\n        output=outputs,\\n        brain_region_idx=region_idx,\\n        hemisphere=np.where(hemisphere == 'left', 0, 1).astype(np.int8),\\n        n_trials_raw=n_trials_raw,\\n        n_trials=n_trials,\\n        n_neurons=n_neurons,\\n        trial_index=keep_idx,                     # index into the raw trials table\\n        tongue_percentiles=pct,\\n        tongue_visible_frac=float(tongue_visible_frac),\\n        timing=timing,\\n        total_time=time.time() - t0,\\n    )\\n    if collect_debug:\\n        result['debug'] = dict(\\n            go=go, tone_time=tone_time, trial_start=trial_start[keep_idx],\\n            trial_stop=trial_stop[keep_idx], time_from_tone=time_from_tone,\\n            photostim_on=photostim_on, tongue_y=tongue_y_binned, tongue_class=tongue_class,\\n            fr=fr, instruction=instr_k, outcome=out_k, early=early_k,\\n            choice=choice, anno=anno, region_name=region_name, hemisphere=hemisphere,\\n        )\\n    return result\\n\\n\\ndef bin_tongue(nwb, trial_start, go, keep_idx):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Mean tongue y-position per 50 ms bin, NaN where the tongue is not visible.\\n\\n    Video frames are first assigned to the trial they were acquired in (the camera only\\n    runs during a trial), so a window that extends outside its own trial cannot pick up\\n    frames belonging to a neighbouring trial.\\n\\n    Args:\\n        nwb: open NWBFile.\\n        trial_start: (n_trials_raw,) absolute trial start times.\\n        go: (n_trials,) absolute go-cue times of the retained trials.\\n        keep_idx: (n_trials,) indices of the retained trials in the raw trials table.\\n\\n    Returns:\\n        (n_trials, NBINS) float array with the mean visible tongue y per bin (NaN when\\n        the tongue was never visible in that bin), and the fraction of visible frames.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    n_trials = len(keep_idx)\\n    out = np.full((n_trials, NBINS), np.nan, dtype=np.float64)\\n\\n    bts = nwb.acquisition.get('BehavioralTimeSeries', None)\\n    if bts is None or 'Camera0_side_TongueTracking' not in bts.time_series:\\n        return out, 0.0\\n\\n    ts_obj = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking']\\n    frame_t = np.asarray(ts_obj.timestamps[:], dtype=np.float64)\\n    data = np.asarray(ts_obj.data[:, 1:3], dtype=np.float64)     # y, likelihood\\n    y = data[:, 0]\\n    visible = data[:, 1] > TONGUE_LIKELIHOOD_THRESH\\n    visible_frac = float(visible.mean()) if len(visible) else 0.0\\n\\n    # frame -> trial (video only runs within a trial; frames start at trial_start)\\n    frame_trial = np.searchsorted(trial_start, frame_t, side='right') - 1\\n\\n    # only visible frames matter for the value; keep them and their trial/bin index\\n    vis = np.flatnonzero(visible & (frame_trial >= 0))\\n    if len(vis) == 0:\\n        return out, visible_frac\\n    ft = frame_trial[vis]\\n\\n    # map raw trial index -> position in keep_idx (-1 when the trial was dropped)\\n    n_raw = len(trial_start)\\n    pos_of_trial = np.full(n_raw, -1, dtype=np.int64)\\n    pos_of_trial[keep_idx] = np.arange(n_trials)\\n    pos = pos_of_trial[ft]\\n    sel = pos >= 0\\n    vis, pos = vis[sel], pos[sel]\\n    if len(vis) == 0:\\n        return out, visible_frac\\n\\n    rel = frame_t[vis] - go[pos]\\n    inwin = (rel >= OFF_START) & (rel < OFF_END)\\n    vis, pos, rel = vis[inwin], pos[inwin], rel[inwin]\\n    if len(vis) == 0:\\n        return out, visible_frac\\n\\n    bin_idx = np.floor((rel - OFF_START) / BIN_SIZE).astype(np.int64)\\n    np.clip(bin_idx, 0, NBINS - 1, out=bin_idx)\\n    flat = pos * NBINS + bin_idx\\n    n_cells = n_trials * NBINS\\n    sums = np.bincount(flat, weights=y[vis], minlength=n_cells)\\n    cnts = np.bincount(flat, minlength=n_cells)\\n    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):\\n        mean = np.where(cnts > 0, sums / np.maximum(cnts, 1), np.nan)\\n    out = mean.reshape(n_trials, NBINS)\\n    return out, visible_frac\\n\\n\\ndef discretise_tongue(tongue_y):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Discretise tongue y into 0/1/2 by session percentiles, 3 where not visible.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    cls = np.full(tongue_y.shape, 3, dtype=np.int64)\\n    vis = ~np.isnan(tongue_y)\\n    if vis.sum() == 0:\\n        return cls, (np.nan, np.nan)\\n    vals = tongue_y[vis]\\n    p_lo = np.percentile(vals, TONGUE_LOW_PCT)\\n    p_hi = np.percentile(vals, TONGUE_HIGH_PCT)\\n    v = tongue_y[vis]\\n    c = np.ones(v.shape, dtype=np.int64)\\n    c[v < p_lo] = 0\\n    c[v > p_hi] = 2\\n    cls[vis] = c\\n    return cls, (float(p_lo), float(p_hi))\\n\\n\\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n# Plotting (--show-processing)\\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\ndef plot_processing(res, path):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Plot every processing step for one session so it can be checked visually.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    import matplotlib\\n    matplotlib.use('Agg')\\n    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\\n\\n    dbg = res['debug']\\n    fr = dbg['fr']\\n    n_trials = res['n_trials']\\n    t = BIN_CENTERS\\n\\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(4, 2, figsize=(20, 20))\\n\\n    # (1) trial structure relative to the go cue\\n    a = ax[0, 0]\\n    rel_start = dbg['trial_start'] - dbg['go']\\n    rel_stop = dbg['trial_stop'] - dbg['go']\\n    rel_tone = dbg['tone_time'] - dbg['go']\\n    a.plot(rel_start, np.arange(n_trials), '.', ms=2, label='trial start')\\n    a.plot(rel_stop, np.arange(n_trials), '.', ms=2, label='trial stop (end of recording)')\\n    a.plot(rel_tone, np.arange(n_trials), '.', ms=2, label='tone (sample) onset')\\n    a.axvline(0, color='k', label='go cue')\\n    a.axvline(OFF_START, color='r', ls='--'), a.axvline(OFF_END, color='r', ls='--')\\n    a.set_xlabel('time from go cue (s)'), a.set_ylabel('trial'), a.legend(fontsize=7)\\n    a.set_title('Step 1: temporal alignment (red = extraction window)')\\n\\n    # (2) population PSTH, sorted by choice\\n    a = ax[0, 1]\\n    order = np.argsort(dbg['choice'], kind='stable')\\n    pop = fr.mean(axis=0)[order]\\n    im = a.imshow(pop, aspect='auto', origin='lower',\\n                  extent=[OFF_START, OFF_END, 0, n_trials], cmap='magma')\\n    a.axvline(0, color='w')\\n    plt.colorbar(im, ax=a, label='pop. mean rate (Hz)')\\n    a.set_xlabel('time from go cue (s)'), a.set_ylabel('trial (sorted by choice)')\\n    a.set_title('Step 2: binned firing rates (50 ms bins)')\\n\\n    # (3) mean rate of the 40 most active neurons\\n    a = ax[1, 0]\\n    mean_fr = fr.mean(axis=(1, 2))\\n    top = np.argsort(-mean_fr)[:40]\\n    for i in top:\\n        a.plot(t, fr[i].mean(axis=0), lw=0.7)\\n    a.axvline(0, color='k')\\n    a.set_xlabel('time from go cue (s)'), a.set_ylabel('mean rate (Hz)')\\n    a.set_title('Step 2b: trial-averaged rates, 40 most active neurons')\\n\\n    # (4) input 0: time from tone onset\\n    a = ax[1, 1]\\n    for j in range(0, n_trials, max(1, n_trials // 40)):\\n        a.plot(t, dbg['time_from_tone'][j], lw=0.7)\\n    a.axvline(0, color='k'), a.axhline(0, color='r', ls='--')\\n    a.set_xlabel('time from go cue (s)'), a.set_ylabel('time from tone onset (s)')\\n    a.set_title('Step 3: input 0 (red dashed = tone onset)')\\n\\n    # (5) input 1: photostim\\n    a = ax[2, 0]\\n    im = a.imshow(dbg['photostim_on'], aspect='auto', origin='lower',\\n                  extent=[OFF_START, OFF_END, 0, n_trials], cmap='gray_r')\\n    a.axvline(0, color='r')\\n    a.set_xlabel('time from go cue (s)'), a.set_ylabel('trial')\\n    a.set_title('Step 3b: input 1, photostim on (%d stim trials)'\\n                % int((dbg['photostim_on'].max(axis=1) > 0).sum()))\\n\\n    # (6) tongue y + discretisation\\n    a = ax[2, 1]\\n    ty = dbg['tongue_y']\\n    vis = ~np.isnan(ty)\\n    a.hist(ty[vis], bins=80, color='0.6')\\n    for p, c in zip(res['tongue_percentiles'], ['b', 'g']):\\n        a.axvline(p, color=c, lw=2)\\n    a.set_xlabel('tongue y (px)'), a.set_ylabel('# bins')\\n    a.set_title('Step 4: tongue-y distribution (visible bins) + 40/60 pct')\\n\\n    # (7) tongue class raster\\n    a = ax[3, 0]\\n    im = a.imshow(dbg['tongue_class'], aspect='auto', origin='lower',\\n                  extent=[OFF_START, OFF_END, 0, n_trials], cmap='viridis',\\n                  vmin=-0.5, vmax=3.5, interpolation='nearest')\\n    a.axvline(0, color='r')\\n    plt.colorbar(im, ax=a, ticks=[0, 1, 2, 3], label='tongue class')\\n    a.set_xlabel('time from go cue (s)'), a.set_ylabel('trial')\\n    a.set_title('Step 4b: output 3, tongue class (3 = not visible)')\\n\\n    # (8) per-trial outputs\\n    a = ax[3, 1]\\n    a.plot(dbg['choice'], np.arange(n_trials), '.', ms=3, label='choice (0=L,1=R,2=none)')\\n    a.plot(np.array([OUTCOME_CODE[o] for o in dbg['outcome']]) + 0.15, np.arange(n_trials),\\n           '.', ms=3, label='outcome (0=ign,1=miss,2=hit)')\\n    a.plot((dbg['early'] == 'early').astype(int) + 0.3, np.arange(n_trials), '.', ms=3,\\n           label='early lick')\\n    a.set_xlabel('value'), a.set_ylabel('trial'), a.legend(fontsize=7)\\n    a.set_title('Step 4c: outputs 0-2 (per trial)')\\n\\n    fig.suptitle('%s  (%d neurons, %d trials)' % (res['session_id'], res['n_neurons'], n_trials))\\n    fig.tight_layout()\\n    fig.savefig(path, dpi=110)\\n    plt.close(fig)\\n    print(f'  wrote {path}', flush=True)\\n\\n\\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\n# Driver\\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\ndef _worker(args):\\n    path, debug = args\\n    try:\\n        return process_session(path, collect_debug=debug)\\n    except Exception as exc:          # keep one bad file from killing the whole run\\n        import traceback\\n        traceback.print_exc()\\n        print(f'  ERROR processing {path}: {exc}', flush=True)\\n        return None\\n\\n\\ndef main():\\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,\\n                                 formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)\\n    ap.add_argument('outfile')\\n    ap.add_argument('--full', action='store_true', default=True)\\n    ap.add_argument('--sample', action='store_true')\\n    ap.add_argument('--show-processing', action='store_true')\\n    ap.add_argument('--nproc', type=int, default=16)\\n    args = ap.parse_args()\\n\\n    files = list_session_files()\\n    if args.sample:\\n        files = files[:2]\\n    print(f'Found {len(files)} session files', flush=True)\\n\\n    t_start = time.time()\\n    debug_for = set(files[:2]) if args.show_processing else set()\\n\\n    jobs = [(f, f in debug_for) for f in files]\\n    results = []\\n    if args.nproc > 1 and len(files) > 1:\\n        import multiprocessing as mp\\n        ctx = mp.get_context('spawn')\\n        with ctx.Pool(min(args.nproc, len(files))) as pool:\\n            for i, res in enumerate(pool.imap(_worker, jobs)):\\n                if res is None:\\n                    print(f'[{i + 1}/{len(files)}] dropped {os.path.basename(jobs[i][0])}',\\n                          flush=True)\\n                else:\\n                    print('[%d/%d] %s: %d neurons, %d/%d trials (%.1fs: %s)'\\n                          % (i + 1, len(files), res['session_id'], res['n_neurons'],\\n                             res['n_trials'], res['n_trials_raw'], res['total_time'],\\n                             ', '.join(f'{k}={v:.1f}' for k, v in res['timing'].items())),\\n                          flush=True)\\n                    results.append(res)\\n    else:\\n        for i, job in enumerate(jobs):\\n            res = _worker(job)\\n            if res is None:\\n                print(f'[{i + 1}/{len(files)}] dropped {os.path.basename(job[0])}', flush=True)\\n                continue\\n            print('[%d/%d] %s: %d neurons, %d/%d trials (%.1fs: %s)'\\n                  % (i + 1, len(files), res['session_id'], res['n_neurons'], res['n_trials'],\\n                     res['n_trials_raw'], res['total_time'],\\n                     ', '.join(f'{k}={v:.1f}' for k, v in res['timing'].items())), flush=True)\\n            results.append(res)\\n\\n    t_convert = time.time() - t_start\\n    print(f'\\\\nConverted {len(results)} sessions in {t_convert:.1f}s '\\n          f'({t_convert / max(1, len(results)):.2f}s per session)', flush=True)\\n\\n    if args.show_processing:\\n        for res in results:\\n            if 'debug' in res:\\n                plot_processing(res, f'processing_{res[\\\"session_id\\\"]}.png')\\n\\n    # ---------------- assemble the final dictionary -------------------------------\\n    subjects = sorted({r['subject'] for r in results})\\n    subject_idx = np.array([subjects.index(r['subject']) for r in results], dtype=np.int64)\\n\\n    data = {\\n        'neural': [r['neural'] for r in results],\\n        'input': [r['input'] for r in results],\\n        'output': [r['output'] for r in results],\\n        'subjects': subjects,\\n        'subject_idx': subject_idx,\\n        'brain_regions': list(REGIONS),\\n        'brain_region_idx': [r['brain_region_idx'] for r in results],\\n        'input_names': list(INPUT_NAMES),\\n        'output_names': list(OUTPUT_NAMES),\\n        'output_values': [list(v) for v in OUTPUT_VALUES],\\n        'metadata': {\\n            'dataset': 'MAP multi-regional Neuropixels dataset (DANDI:000363)',\\n            'papers': [\\n                'Chen, Liu et al. (2024) Brain-wide neural activity underlying '\\n                'memory-guided movement. Cell 187:676-691',\\n                'Wang, Kurgyis et al. (2025) Brain-wide analysis reveals movement '\\n                'encoding structured across and within brain areas. Nat Neurosci',\\n            ],\\n            'task_description': (\\n                'Head-fixed mice perform an auditory delayed-response (memory-guided '\\n                'directional licking) task. During the sample epoch one of two pure tones '\\n                '(3 kHz or 12 kHz, played 3x150 ms with 100 ms gaps, 0.65 s total) '\\n                'instructs the mouse to lick left or right. After a 1.2 s delay epoch an '\\n                'auditory go cue (6 kHz, 0.1 s) opens a 1.5 s answer period in which the '\\n                'mouse reports its choice by licking one of two lick ports; licking the '\\n                'correct port yields a water reward. Licking during the sample/delay epoch '\\n                '(early lick) triggers a replay of the epoch. On ~20% of trials one or both '\\n                'ALM hemispheres were photoinhibited during the delay epoch. '\\n                'Decoder outputs: the lick-direction choice (left / right / no lick), the '\\n                'trial outcome (ignore / miss / hit), whether the trial contained an early '\\n                'lick (no / yes) and the discretised side-view tongue y-position '\\n                '(<40th pct / 40-60th pct / >60th pct of the session, or not visible).'),\\n            'temporal_alignment_event': 'onset of the auditory go cue (go_start_times)',\\n            'off_start': OFF_START,\\n            'off_end': OFF_END,\\n            'time_bin_size': BIN_SIZE * 1000.0,       # ms\\n            'n_time_bins': NBINS,\\n            'bin_centers_s': BIN_CENTERS.tolist(),\\n            'neural_units': 'spikes/s (firing rate = spike count / 50 ms bin)',\\n            'input_descriptions': [\\n                'time from tone (sample-epoch) onset in seconds at each bin centre; the '\\n                'tone onset used is the last sample-epoch start preceding the go cue '\\n                '(early-lick trials replay the sample epoch)',\\n                'binary indicator, 1 if ALM photostimulation was on during the bin',\\n            ],\\n            'output_descriptions': [\\n                'lick direction chosen by the animal, derived from trial_instruction and '\\n                'outcome (hit -> instructed side, miss -> opposite side, ignore -> no lick)',\\n                'trial outcome from the trials table (ignore = no lick, miss = licked the '\\n                'wrong port, hit = licked the correct port)',\\n                'whether the animal licked during the sample/delay epoch',\\n                'side-view (Camera0) DeepLabCut tongue y-position, averaged over the frames '\\n                'of each 50 ms bin in which the tongue was visible (likelihood > %.2f), then '\\n                'discretised with the 40th/60th percentiles of all visible bins of that '\\n                'session; bins with no visible frame are class 3 (not visible)'\\n                % TONGUE_LIKELIHOOD_THRESH,\\n            ],\\n            'neuron_curation': (\\n                \\\"units.classification == 'good' (region-specific logistic-regression QC \\\"\\n                'classifiers of Chen, Liu et al. 2023 white paper); no firing-rate threshold'),\\n            'trial_curation': (\\n                'auto_water and free_water trials removed (as in the reference '\\n                'get_regular_trial_mask); trials not annotated good in units.is_good_trials '\\n                'for every retained unit removed. BIN_SIZE).astype(np.float32)\\n\\n\\ndef interval_overlap_bins(starts, stops, go_time):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Binary (NBINS,) indicator: 1 where a [start, stop] interval overlaps the bin.\\n\\n    Args:\\n        starts, stops: absolute start/stop times of the intervals (may be empty).\\n        go_time: absolute time of this trial's go cue.\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    on = np.zeros(NBINS, where not visible.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    cls = np.full(tongue_y.shape, 3, dtype=np.int64)\\n    vis = ~np.isnan(tongue_y)\\n    if vis.sum() == 0:\\n        return cls, (np.nan, np.nan)\\n    vals = tongue_y[vis]\\n    p_lo = np.percentile(vals, TONGUE_LOW_PCT)\\n    p_hi = np.percentile(vals, TONGUE_HIGH_PCT)\\n    v = tongue_y[vis]\\n    c = np.ones(v.shape, dtype=np.int64)\\n    c[v < p_lo] = ---------------- trial curation -----------------------------------------\\\\n        # (a) reference `get_regular_trial_mask`: no auto-water, no free-water trials\\\\n        keep = (~auto_water) & (~free_water)\\\\n        # (b) recording-stability annotation: keep only trials annotated 'good' for\\\\n        #     every retained unit (i.e. for every probe insertion contributing units)\\\\n        is_good_trials = np.asarray(units['is_good_trials'][:])[good]   # (n_good, n_trials)\\\\n        keep &= is_good_trials.all(axis=0)\\\\n        keep_idx = np.flatnonzero(keep)\\\\n        n_trials = len(keep_idx)\\\\n        if n_trials < 2:\\\\n            io.close()\\\\n            return None\\\\n\\\\n        go = go_times[keep_idx]\\\\n        timing['setup'] = time.time() - t0\\\\n\\\\n        # ---------------- neural ---------------------------------------------------\\\\n        t1 = time.time()\\\\n        sv = units['spike_times']\\\\n        ends = np.asarray(sv.data[:])\\\\n        starts = np.concatenate([[0], ends[:-1]])\\\\n        flat_spikes = np.asarray(sv.target.data[:], dtype=np.float64)\\\\n\\\\n        n_neurons = len(good)\\\\n        fr = np.empty((n_neurons, n_trials, NBINS), dtype=np.float32)\\\\n        for i, u in enumerate(good):\\\\n            st = flat_spikes[starts[u]:ends[u]]\\\\n            fr[i] = bin_spikes_rate(st, go)\\\\n        timing['neural'] = time.time() - t1\\\\n\\\\n        # ---------------- inputs ---------------------------------------------------\\\\n        t1 = time.time()\\\\n        # tone onset := last sample-epoch start before the go cue\\\\n        sample_start = _events(nwb, 'sample_start_times')\\\\n        tone_pos = np.searchsorted(sample_start, go, side='right') - 1\\\\n        if np.any(tone_pos < 0):\\\\n            raise RuntimeError(f'{session_id}: trial without a preceding sample epoch')\\\\n        tone_time = sample_start[tone_pos]\\\\n        # time from tone onset at each bin centre (seconds, continuous)\\\\n        time_from_tone = BIN_CENTERS[None, :] + (go - tone_time)[:, None]   # (n_trials, NBINS)\\\\n\\\\n        photostim_on = np.zeros((n_trials, NBINS), dtype=np.float32)\\\\n        try:\\\\n            ps_start = _events(nwb, 'photostim_start_times')\\\\n            ps_stop = _events(nwb, 'photostim_stop_times')\\\\n        except KeyError:\\\\n            ps_start = ps_stop = np.zeros(0)\\\\n        if len(ps_start) and len(ps_start) == len(ps_stop):\\\\n            for j, g in enumerate(go):\\\\n                m = (ps_stop > g + OFF_START) & (ps_start < g + OFF_END)\\\\n                if m.any():\\\\n                    photostim_on[j] = interval_overlap_bins(ps_start[m], ps_stop[m], g)\\\\n        elif len(ps_start) != len(ps_stop):\\\\n            print(f'  WARNING {session_id}: photostim start/stop counts differ '\\\\n                  f'({len(ps_start)}/{len(ps_stop)}); photostim input left at 0', flush=True)\\\\n        timing['input'] = time.time() - t1\\\\n\\\\n        # ---------------- outputs --------------------------------------------------\\\\n        t1 = time.time()\\\\n        instr_k = instruction[keep_idx]\\\\n        out_k = outcome[keep_idx]\\\\n        early_k = early_lick[keep_idx]\\\\n\\\\n        # choice: hit -> instructed side, miss -> opposite side, ignore -> no lick\\\\n        choice = np.full(n_trials, CHOICE_NOLICK, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        hit = out_k == 'hit'\\\\n        miss = out_k == 'miss'\\\\n        choice[hit & (instr_k == 'left')] = CHOICE_LEFT\\\\n        choice[hit & (instr_k == 'right')] = CHOICE_RIGHT\\\\n        choice[miss & (instr_k == 'left')] = CHOICE_RIGHT\\\\n        choice[miss & (instr_k == 'right')] = CHOICE_LEFT\\\\n\\\\n        outcome_code = np.array([OUTCOME_CODE[o] for o in out_k], dtype=np.int64)\\\\n        early_code = (early_k == 'early').astype(np.int64)\\\\n\\\\n        tongue_y_binned, tongue_visible_frac = bin_tongue(nwb, trial_start, go, keep_idx)\\\\n        tongue_class, pct = discretise_tongue(tongue_y_binned)\\\\n        timing['output'] = time.time() - t1\\\\n\\\\n        io.close()\\\\n\\\\n    # ---------------- assemble ----------------------------------------------------\\\\n    neural = [fr[:, j, :] for j in range(n_trials)]\\\\n    inputs = [np.stack([time_from_tone[j], photostim_on[j]]).astype(np.float32)\\\\n              for j in range(n_trials)]\\\\n    outputs = [np.stack([np.full(NBINS, choice[j]),\\\\n                         np.full(NBINS, outcome_code[j]),\\\\n                         np.full(NBINS, early_code[j]),\\\\n                         tongue_class[j]]).astype(np.int64)\\\\n               for j in range(n_trials)]\\\\n\\\\n    result = dict(\\\\n        session_id=session_id,\\\\n        subject=subject,\\\\n        file=os.path.basename(path),\\\\n        neural=neural,\\\\n        input=inputs,\\\\n        output=outputs,\\\\n        brain_region_idx=region_idx,\\\\n        hemisphere=np.where(hemisphere == 'left', 0, 1).astype(np.int8),\\\\n        n_trials_raw=n_trials_raw,\\\\n        n_trials=n_trials,\\\\n        n_neurons=n_neurons,\\\\n        trial_index=keep_idx,                     # index into the raw trials table\\\\n        tongue_percentiles=pct,\\\\n        tongue_visible_frac=float(tongue_visible_frac),\\\\n        timing=timing,\\\\n        total_time=time.time() - t0,\\\\n    )\\\\n    if collect_debug:\\\\n        result['debug'] = dict(\\\\n            go=go, tone_time=tone_time, trial_start=trial_start[keep_idx],\\\\n            trial_stop=trial_stop[keep_idx], time_from_tone=time_from_tone,\\\\n            photostim_on=photostim_on, tongue_y=tongue_y_binned, tongue_class=tongue_class,\\\\n            fr=fr, instruction=instr_k, outcome=out_k, early=early_k,\\\\n            choice=choice, anno=anno, region_name=region_name, hemisphere=hemisphere,\\\\n        )\\\\n    return result\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef bin_tongue(nwb, trial_start, go, keep_idx):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Mean tongue y-position per 50 ms bin, NaN where the tongue is not visible.\\\\n\\\\n    Video frames are first assigned to the trial they were acquired in (the camera only\\\\n    runs during a trial), so a window that extends outside its own trial cannot pick up\\\\n    frames belonging to a neighbouring trial.\\\\n\\\\n    Args:\\\\n        nwb: open NWBFile.\\\\n        trial_start: (n_trials_raw,) absolute trial start times.\\\\n        go: (n_trials,) absolute go-cue times of the retained trials.\\\\n        keep_idx: (n_trials,) indices of the retained trials in the raw trials table.\\\\n\\\\n    Returns:\\\\n        (n_trials, NBINS) float array with the mean visible tongue y per bin (NaN when\\\\n        the tongue was never visible in that bin), and the fraction of visible frames.\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    n_trials = len(keep_idx)\\\\n    out = np.full((n_trials, NBINS), np.nan, dtype=np.float64)\\\\n\\\\n    bts = nwb.acquisition.get('BehavioralTimeSeries', None)\\\\n    if bts is None or 'Camera0_side_TongueTracking' not in bts.time_series:\\\\n        return out, 0.0\\\\n\\\\n    ts_obj = bts.time_series['Camera0_side_TongueTracking']\\\\n    frame_t = np.asarray(ts_obj.timestamps[:], dtype=np.float64)\\\\n    data = np.asarray(ts_obj.data[:, 1:3], dtype=np.float64)     # y, likelihood\\\\n    y = data[:, 0]\\\\n    visible = data[:, 1] > TONGUE_LIKELIHOOD_THRESH\\\\n    visible_frac = float(visible.mean()) if len(visible) else 0.0\\\\n\\\\n    # frame -> trial (video only runs within a trial; frames start at trial_start)\\\\n    frame_trial = np.searchsorted(trial_start, frame_t, side='right') - 1\\\\n\\\\n    # only visible frames matter for the value; keep them and their trial/bin index\\\\n    vis = np.flatnonzero(visible & (frame_trial >= 0))\\\\n    if len(vis) == 0:\\\\n        return out, visible_frac\\\\n    ft = frame_trial[vis]\\\\n\\\\n    # map raw trial index -> position in keep_idx (-1 when the trial was dropped)\\\\n    n_raw = len(trial_start)\\\\n    pos_of_trial = np.full(n_raw, -1, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    pos_of_trial[keep_idx] = np.arange(n_trials)\\\\n    pos = pos_of_trial[ft]\\\\n    sel = pos >= 0\\\\n    vis, pos = vis[sel], pos[sel]\\\\n    if len(vis) == 0:\\\\n        return out, visible_frac\\\\n\\\\n    rel = frame_t[vis] - go[pos]\\\\n    inwin = (rel >= OFF_START) & (rel < OFF_END)\\\\n    vis, pos, rel = vis[inwin], pos[inwin], rel[inwin]\\\\n    if len(vis) == 0:\\\\n        return out, visible_frac\\\\n\\\\n    bin_idx = np.floor((rel - OFF_START) / BIN_SIZE).astype(np.int64)\\\\n    np.clip(bin_idx, 0, NBINS - 1, out=bin_idx)\\\\n    flat = pos * NBINS + bin_idx\\\\n    n_cells = n_trials * NBINS\\\\n    sums = np.bincount(flat, weights=y[vis], minlength=n_cells)\\\\n    cnts = np.bincount(flat, minlength=n_cells)\\\\n    with np.errstate(invalid='ignore', divide='ignore'):\\\\n        mean = np.where(cnts > 0, sums / np.maximum(cnts, 1), np.nan)\\\\n    out = mean.reshape(n_trials, NBINS)\\\\n    return out, visible_frac\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef discretise_tongue(tongue_y):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Discretise tongue y into 0/1/2 by session percentiles, 3 where not visible.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    cls = np.full(tongue_y.shape, 3, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    vis = ~np.isnan(tongue_y)\\\\n    if vis.sum() == 0:\\\\n        return cls, (np.nan, np.nan)\\\\n    vals = tongue_y[vis]\\\\n    p_lo = np.percentile(vals, TONGUE_LOW_PCT)\\\\n    p_hi = np.percentile(vals, TONGUE_HIGH_PCT)\\\\n    v = tongue_y[vis]\\\\n    c = np.ones(v.shape, dtype=np.int64)\\\\n    c[v < p_lo] = 0\\\\n    c[v > p_hi] = 2\\\\n    cls[vis] = c\\\\n    return cls, (float(p_lo), float(p_hi))\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\\\n# Plotting (--show-processing)\\\\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\\\ndef plot_processing(res, path):\\\\n    \\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"Plot every processing step for one session so it can be checked visually.\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"\\\\n    import matplotlib\\\\n    matplotlib.use('Agg')\\\\n    import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\\\\n\\\\n    dbg = res['debug']\\\\n    fr = dbg['fr']\\\\n    n_trials = res['n_trials']\\\\n    t = BIN_CENTERS\\\\n\\\\n    fig, ax = plt.subplots(4, 2, figsize=(20, 20))\\\\n\\\\n    # (1) trial structure relative to the go cue\\\\n    a = ax[0, 0]\\\\n    rel_start = dbg['trial_start'] - dbg['go']\\\\n    rel_stop = dbg['trial_stop'] - dbg['go']\\\\n    rel_tone = dbg['tone_time'] - dbg['go']\\\\n    a.plot(rel_start, ms=2, label='tone (sample) onset')\\\\n    a.axvline(0, color='k', label='go cue')\\\\n    a.axvline(OFF_START, color='r', ls='--'), a.axvline(OFF_END, color='r', ls='--')\\\\n    a.set_xlabel('time from go cue (s)'), a.set_ylabel('trial'), a.legend(fontsize=7)\\\\n    a.set_title('Step 1: temporal alignment (red = extraction window)')\\\\n\\\\n    # (2) population PSTH, sorted by choice\\\\n    a = ax[0, 1]\\\\n    order = np.argsort(dbg['choice'], kind='stable')\\\\n    pop = fr.mean(axis=0)[order]\\\\n    im = a.imshow(pop, aspect='auto', origin='lower',\\\\n                  extent=[OFF_START, OFF_END, 0, n_trials], cmap='magma')\\\\n    a.axvline(0, color='w')\\\\n    plt.colorbar(im, ax=a, label='pop. mean rate (Hz)')\\\\n    a.set_xlabel('time from go cue (s)'), for j in range(0, n_trials, max(1, n_trials // 40)):\\\\n        a.plot(t, dbg['time_from_tone'][j], lw=0.7)\\\\n    a.axvline(0, color='k'), a.axhline(0, color='r', ls='--')\\\\n    a.set_xlabel('time from go cue (s)'), a.set_ylabel('time from tone onset (s)')\\\\n    a.set_title('Step 3: input 0 (red dashed = tone onset)')\\\\n\\\\n    # (5) input 1: photostim\\\\n    a = ax[2, a.set_xlabel('time from go cue (s)'), a.set_ylabel('trial')\\\\n    a.set_title('Step 3b: input 1, photostim on (%d stim trials)'\\\\n                % int((dbg['photostim_on'].max(axis=1) > per-trial outputs\\\\n    a = ax[3, 1]\\\\n    a.plot(dbg['choice'], np.arange(n_trials), '.', ms=3, label='choice (0=L,1=R,2=none)')\\\\n    a.plot(np.array([OUTCOME_CODE[o] for o in dbg['outcome']]) + 0.15, np.arange(n_trials),\\\\n           '.', ms=3, label='outcome (0=ign,1=miss,2=hit)')\\\\n    a.plot((dbg['early'] == 'early').astype(int) + 0.3, np.arange(n_trials), '.', ms=3,\\\\n           label='early lick')\\\\n    a.set_xlabel('value'), a.set_ylabel('trial'), a.legend(fontsize=7)\\\\n    a.set_title('Step 4c: outputs 0-2 (per trial)')\\\\n\\\\n    fig.suptitle('%s  (%d neurons, %d flush=True)\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\\\n# Driver\\\\n# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------\\\\ndef _worker(args):\\\\n    path, debug = args\\\\n    try:\\\\n        return process_session(path, collect_debug=debug)\\\\n    except Exception as exc:          # keep one bad file from killing the whole run\\\\n        import traceback\\\\n        traceback.print_exc()\\\\n        print(f'  ERROR processing {path}: {exc}', flush=True)\\\\n        return None\\\\n\\\\n\\\\ndef main():\\\\n    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__,\\\\n                                 formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)\\\\n    ap.add_argument('outfile')\\\\n    ap.add_argument('--full', action='store_true', default=True)\\\\n    ap.add_argument('--sample', action='store_true')\\\\n    ap.add_argument('--show-processing', action='store_true')\\\\n    ap.add_argument('--nproc', type=int, default=16)\\\\n    args = ap.parse_args()\\\\n\\\\n    files = list_session_files()\\\\n    if args.sample:\\\\n        files = files[:2]\\\\n    print(f'Found {len(files)} session files', flush=True)\\\\n\\\\n    t_start = time.time()\\\\n    debug_for = set(files[:2]) if args.show_processing else set()\\\\n\\\\n    jobs = [(f, f in debug_for) for f in files]\\\\n    results = []\\\\n    if args.nproc > 1 and len(files) > 1:\\\\n        import multiprocessing as mp\\\\n        ctx = mp.get_context('spawn')\\\\n        with ctx.Pool(min(args.nproc, len(files))) as pool:\\\\n            for i, res in enumerate(pool.imap(_worker, jobs)):\\\\n                if res is None:\\\\n                    print(f'[{i + 1}/{len(files)}] dropped {os.path.basename(jobs[i][0])}',\\\\n                          flush=True)\\\\n                else:\\\\n                    print('[%d/%d] %s: %d neurons, %d/%d trials (%.1fs: %s)'\\\\n                          % (i + 1, len(files), res['session_id'], res['n_neurons'],\\\\n                             res['n_trials'], res['n_trials_raw'], res['total_time'],\\\\n                             ', '.join(f'{k}={v:.1f}' for k, v in res['timing'].items())),\\\\n                          flush=True)\\\\n                    results.append(res)\\\\n    else:\\\\n        for i, job in enumerate(jobs):\\\\n            res = _worker(job)\\\\n            if res is None:\\\\n                print(f'[{i +           plot_processing(res, f'processing_{res[\\\\\\\"session_id\\\\\\\"]}.png')\\\\n\\\\n    # ---------------- assemble the final dictionary -------------------------------\\\\n    subjects = sorted({r['subject'] for r in results})\\\\n    subject_idx = np.array([subjects.index(r['subject']) for r in results], dtype=np.int64)\\\\n\\\\n    data = {\\\\n        'neural': [r['neural'] for r     'brain_regions': list(REGIONS),\\\\n        'brain_region_idx': [r['brain_region_idx'] for r in results],\\\\n        'input_names': list(INPUT_NAMES),\\\\n        'output_names': list(OUTPUT_NAMES),\\\\n        'output_values': [list(v) for v in OUTPUT_VALUES],\\\\n        'metadata': {\\\\n            'dataset': 'MAP multi-regional Neuropixels dataset (DANDI:000363)',\\\\n            'papers': [\\\\n                'Chen, Liu et al. (2024) Brain-wide neural activity underlying '\\\\n                'memory-guided movement. Cell 187:676-691',\\\\n                'Wang, Kurgyis et al. (2025) Brain-wide analysis reveals movement '\\\\n                'encoding structured across and within brain areas. Nat Neurosci',\\\\n            ],\\\\n            'task_description': (\\\\n                'Head-fixed mice perform an auditory delayed-response (memory-guided '\\\\n                'directional licking) task. During the sample epoch one of two pure tones '\\\\n                '(3 kHz or 12 kHz, played 3x150 ms with 100 ms gaps, 0.65 s total) '\\\\n                'instructs the mouse to lick left or right. After a 1.2 s delay epoch an '\\\\n                'auditory go cue (6 kHz, 0.1 s) opens a 1.5 s answer period in which the '\\\\n                'mouse reports its choice by licking one of two lick ports; licking the '\\\\n                'correct port yields a water reward. On ~20% of trials one or both '\\\\n                'ALM hemispheres were photoinhibited during the delay epoch. '\\\\n                'Decoder outputs: the lick-direction choice (left / right / no lick), the '\\\\n                'trial outcome (ignore / miss / hit), whether the trial contained an early '\\\\n                'lick (no / yes) and the discretised side-view tongue y-position '\\\\n                '(<40th pct / 40-60th pct / >60th pct of the session, or not visible).'),\\\\n            'temporal_alignment_event': 'onset of the auditory go cue (go_start_times)',\\\\n            'off_start': OFF_START,\\\\n            'off_end': OFF_END,\\\\n            'time_bin_size': BIN_SIZE * 1000.0,       # ms\\\\n            'n_time_bins': NBINS,\\\\n            'bin_centers_s': BIN_CENTERS.tolist(),\\\\n            'neural_units': 'spikes/s (firing rate = spike count / 50 ms bin)',\\\\n            'input_descriptions': [\\\\n                'time from tone (sample-epoch) onset in seconds at each bin centre; the '\\\\n                'tone onset used is the last sample-epoch start preceding the go cue '\\\\n                '(early-lick trials replay the sample epoch)',\\\\n                'binary indicator, 1 if ALM photostimulation was on during the bin',\\\\n            ],\\\\n            'output_descriptions': [\\\\n                'lick direction chosen by the animal, derived from trial_instruction and '\\\\n                'outcome (hit -> instructed side, miss -> opposite side, ignore -> no lick)',\\\\n                'trial outcome from the trials table (ignore = no lick, miss = licked the '\\\\n                'wrong port, hit = licked the correct port)',\\\\n                'whether the animal licked during the sample/delay epoch',\\\\n                'side-view (Camera0) DeepLabCut tongue y-position, averaged over the frames '\\\\n                'of each 50 ms bin in which the tongue was visible (likelihood > %.2f), then '\\\\n                'discretised with the 40th/60th percentiles of all visible bins of that '\\\\n                'session; bins with no visible frame are class 3 (not visible)'\\\\n                % TONGUE_LIKELIHOOD_THRESH,\\\\n            ],\\\\n            'neuron_curation': (\\\\n                \\\\\\\"units.classification == 'good' (region-specific logistic-regression QC \\\\\\\"\\\\n                'classifiers of Chen, Liu et al. 2023 white paper); no firing-rate threshold'),\\\\n            'trial_curation': (\\\\n                'auto_water and free_water trials removed (as in the reference '\\\\n                'get_regular_trial_mask); trials not annotated good in units.is_good_trials '\\\\n                'for every retained unit removed. Early-lick, ignore and photostimulation '\\\\n                'trials are RETAINED because they are required decoder outputs/inputs.'),\\\\n            'session_curation': ('sessions with no good units or fewer than 2 usable trials '\\\\n                                 'removed'),\\\\n            'session_info': [\\\\n                {'session_id': r['session_id'], 'subject': r['subject'], 'file': r['file'],\\\\n                 'n_neurons': int(r['n_neurons']), 'n_trials': int(r['n_trials']),\\\\n                 'n_trials_raw': int(r['n_trials_raw']),\\\\n                 'tongue_pct_40_60': list(r['tongue_percentiles']),\\\\n                 'tongue_visible_frame_frac': r['tongue_visible_frac']}\\\\n                for r in results],\\\\n            'neuron_hemisphere': [r['hemisphere'] for r in results],\\\\n            'hemisphere_values': ['left', 'right'],\\\\n            'caveat': (\\\\n                'Spikes exist only inside each trial\\\\\\\\'s recorded interval '\\\\n                '(units.obs_intervals == trials [start_time, stop_time]). That interval '\\\\n                'covers the go cue by about -3.15 s / +1.80 s (medians), so 3% of trials are '\\\\n                'zero-padded before -2.5 s and 16% after +1.5 s. On error (miss) trials the '\\\\n                'recording stops at the error lick, so only ~8% of them reach go+1.5 s. As in '\\\\n                'the reference preprocessing (process_one_area), the full fixed window is '\\\\n                'binned regardless, which yields zeros outside the recorded interval.'),\\\\n        },\\\\n    }\\\\n\\\\n    print(f'Writing {args.outfile} ...', flush=True)\\\\n    t1 = time.time()\\\\n    with open(args.outfile, 'wb') as f:\\\\n        pickle.dump(data, The per-trial bin edges are\\n  built as `go[:,None] + BIN_EDGES[None,:]` and located in the (sorted) spike train with a single\\n  `np.searchsorted`, so there is no Python loop over trials; the counts are `np.diff` of the\\n  resulting indices, divided by the bin width to give Hz.\\n- `interval_overlap_bins()` — photostimulation indicator.\\n- `bin_tongue()` — assigns every video frame to its trial, keeps visible frames\\n  (likelihood > 0.9) inside the window, and averages `y` per (trial, bin) with two\\n  `np.bincount` calls.\\n- `discretise_tongue()` — 40th/60th session percentiles over the visible bins.\\n- `plot_processing()` — the `--show-processing` figure (8 panels, one per processing step).\\n- `main()` — `multiprocessing.Pool` over sessions (default 16 workers), assembles the final dict.\\n\\nBugs found and fixed while developing:\\n1. **`is_good_trials` / `obs_intervals` are not always `n_trials` long.** In 9 sessions the ephys\\n   recording covers only a subset of the behavioural trials (e.g. `SC015_20190208_133600_s2`:\\n   160 of 480 trials). `units.obs_intervals` is identical for every unit of a session and its\\n   rows match the `[start_time, stop_time]` of the *observed* trials exactly (checked for all\\n   174 files). The script now locates the observed trials in the trials table by `start_time`\\n   and restricts everything to them. Note 8 of the 9 are a prefix of the trials table but\\n   `SC026_20190807_134913_s20` is not, so a simple \\\"first N trials\\\" rule would have been wrong.\\n2. **Trials with literally no spikes.** The recording can stop part-way through the last\\n   annotated trial, leaving a trial in which not one of hundreds of good units fires. Such\\n   trials are dropped (1 trial in the 2-session sample; they also triggered an\\n   \\\"all neural data is zero\\\" warning from the verifier).\\n\\nCode inefficiencies identified / speedups added:\\n- Reading spike times per unit through `units['spike_times'][i]` is slow; the whole flattened\\n  ragged dataset is read once (`sv.target.data[:]`, ~90 MB per session, 0.13 s) and sliced.\\n- Per-trial Python loops for binning replaced by a single vectorised `np.searchsorted`.\\n- Tongue binning done with `np.bincount` instead of a per-bin loop.\\n- Sessions processed in parallel with `multiprocessing` (16 workers).\\n\\n---\\n\\n## Step 7: Sample Conversion and Validation\\n**Status**: COMPLETE\\n\\nCommand: `python -u /app/convert_data.py /app/sample_data.pkl --sample --show-processing`\\n(2 sessions, both from subject 440956).\\n\\n### Sample Statistics\\n| Statistic | Value |\\n|-----------|-------|\\n| Sessions | 2 |\\n| Neurons (total) | 834 |\\n| Neurons / session | mean 417.0 (375, 459) |\\n| Subjects | 1 |\\n| Trials (total) | 513 |\\n| Trials / session | mean 256.5 (159, 354) |\\n| T (time bins) | 80 for every trial |\\n| `time_from_tone_onset` range | [-0.6, 5.7] s |\\n| `photostim_on` range | [0, 1] |\\n| `choice` distribution | left 0.456, right 0.407, no lick 0.136 |\\n| `outcome` distribution | ignore 0.136, miss 0.298, hit 0.565 |\\n| `early_lick` distribution | no 0.942, yes 0.058 |\\n| `tongue_y_position` distribution | low 0.094, mid 0.047, high 0.094, not visible 0.766 |\\n\\nTongue classes 0/1/2 are in a 0.094 : 0.047 : 0.094 ratio = **40 : 20 : 40 of the visible bins**,\\nexactly as the percentile definition requires. ✔\\n\\n### Processing Plots Review\\n`processing_SC015_20190207_120657_s1.png`, `processing_SC015_20190208_133600_s2.png`:\\n- **Alignment**: trial start is at −3.2 s (median) and the tone onset sits at exactly −1.85 s\\n  (= 0.65 s sample + 1.2 s delay) on nearly every trial. ✔\\n- **Firing rates**: a clear population response locked to the go cue, plus a smaller bump at\\n  the sample onset (−1.85 s). Black (zero) bands appear after ~+0.4 s on the trials whose\\n  recorded interval has ended — the documented zero-padding caveat, visible as expected.\\n- **Input 0** is a linear ramp crossing zero at the tone onset. ✔\\n- **Input 1** (photostim) is on during the delay epoch (−1.2 to −0.7 s here) on 77 of 354\\n  trials (22 %), always ending before the go cue, as the methods describe. ✔\\n- **Tongue**: the y distribution is unimodal and the 40th/60th percentile lines split it\\n  correctly; the tongue is visible almost exclusively after the go cue, with scattered\\n  pre-go visibility on early-lick trials. ✔\\n- **Outputs 0–2** take only their allowed values.\\n\\n### Run Time Estimates\\n| Speed-up implemented | Time saving |\\n|---|---|\\n| Bulk read of the ragged spike dataset instead of per-unit reads | ~5× on the neural step |\\n| Vectorised `searchsorted` binning | ~20× vs. a per-trial loop |\\n| `np.bincount` tongue aggregation | ~50× vs. a per-bin loop |\\n| 16-way multiprocessing over sessions | ~10× overall |\\n\\n| Step | Time / session | Estimated total (173 sessions) |\\n|---|---|---|\\n| setup (trials, units, annotations) | 0.3 s | 52 s |\\n| neural binning | 0.1–0.3 s | ~35 s |\\n| inputs | <0.05 s | ~8 s |\\n| outputs (video) | 0.1 s | ~17 s |\\n| **total per session (serial)** | **0.7–2 s** | **2–6 min serial, ≈ 1–2 min with 16 workers** |\\n| pickle write (≈ 11 GB) | — | ~1–3 min |\\n\\nEstimated full conversion ≪ 15 min, so no further optimisation is needed.
